apis.name: api-cp-ai-rag
apis.title: RAG Service API
apis.description: API for RAG service for document ingestion and answer retrieval.

apis.name: api-cp-crime-caseadmin-dcs-fulfilment
apis.title: Crime Case Administration Status Tracking
apis.description: Status tracking APIs for HMCTS Common Platform crime case administration (DCS fulfilment).

apis.name: api-cp-crime-court-list-publisher
apis.title: Crime Court List Publisher
apis.description: Publishes court lists for downstream court services.

apis.name: api-cp-crime-defendant-details
apis.title: Defendant Details
apis.description: Returns defendant details (name, date of birth) for defendants on a given case

apis.name: api-cp-crime-hearing
apis.title: CP Crime Hearing API
apis.description: Returns hearing lifecycle data for a case: case timeline, defendant attendance at a hearing, and defendants and their offences.

apis.name: api-cp-crime-hearing-results
apis.title: CP Crime Hearing Results API
apis.description: Returns the results recorded at a hearing: offence results, court application results, and any sentence.

apis.name: api-cp-crime-hearing-results-document-subscription
apis.title: Crime Hearing Results Document Subscription
apis.description: Allows organisations to register for and receive notifications when crime hearing result documents become available.

apis.name: api-cp-crime-hearing-results-validator
apis.title: Crime Hearing Results Validator
apis.description: Validates draft hearing results against declarative, programmatic, and LLM-assisted rules.

apis.name: api-cp-crime-prosecution-case
apis.title: CP Crime Prosecution Case API
apis.description: Returns the defendants on a prosecution case and their offences for a given case URN.

apis.name: api-cp-crime-prosecution-case-details
apis.title: Crime Prosecution Case Details
apis.description: Returns a summary of a criminal prosecution case for a given case reference number.

apis.name: api-cp-crime-results-pcr
apis.title: Crime Case Prison Court Register API
apis.description: Returns the prosecution case results recorded at a hearing, per defendant — the result for each offence and each court application, including any sentence handed down, enriched with Reference Data classifications.

apis.name: api-cp-crime-schedulingandlisting-courtschedule
apis.title: Scheduling and Listing Court Schedule
apis.description: Returns the court hearing schedule for a given case, showing when and where hearings are listed.

apis.name: api-cp-refdata-courthearing-courthouses
apis.title: Refdata Court Hearing Courthouses
apis.description: Provides information about court buildings and the rooms within them.

apis.name: cpp-case-aggregator-poc
apis.title: CPP Case Aggregator API
apis.description: Aggregates data from multiple CPP downstream services (system-id-mapper, prosecution-casefile, hearing, results, hearing-nows) and exposes shaped responses per domain.
